_comment: Entry point for the feedback survey, offering the two tracks.
carries no year and is still approved, so it could be reused as-is. It is
recreated here only so that the 2026 round has its own named template and
If there is no Innovation Fair in 2026, drop the second button and the
clause that mentions it - a template offering a track that does not exist
would strand anyone who taps it.
The button ids match the 2023 payloads so the existing Studio split widgets
